description.value: City Avenue Market is a family-owned grocery chain founded in Vancouver in 1986, now operating four locations across Greater Vancouver. The West Broadway store, opened in 2022, specializes in organic, local, and international produce alongside a broad pantry selection including bulk goods, dairy, meat, and fresh baked goods. Touring cyclists will find a well-rounded resupply stop with an emphasis on fresh fruits and vegetables, natural foods, and locally sourced products.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Vancouver Westside / West Broadway location of a multi-location family-owned grocery chain, matching the OSM address (3151 W Broadway, V6K 2H2). The website lists 604-255-1440 as the customer service number, which conflicts with the OSM phone +1-604-732-7088, flagged as a concern. The website confirms a broad grocery offering (produce, bulk, dairy, meat, baked goods, organic) but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities; the deli expansion is explicitly limited to three other locations, not West Broadway.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-732-7088 for this location, but the website contact page lists 604-255-1440 as the customer service number; individual store numbers are not published on the website, so the OSM number cannot be verified.
OSM tag loc_name='Young Bros Produce' suggests a former or alternate business name at this address; the current operator is City Avenue Market (opened May 1, 2022 per website About Us page).
Deli is explicitly listed as available only at New Westminster, Port Coquitlam, and Vancouver Eastside locations — not at this West Broadway location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-stocked independent grocery chain with a strong organic and local produce focus on a major Vancouver cycling corridor (West Broadway); a solid resupply option for touring cyclists even though cycling-specific amenities are unconfirmed.
